_README: tokio is GONE from Perry's workspace (final tokio lane; docs/turnloop/p8-report.md).
scripts/tokio_inventory.py (a `lint` step) fails on ANY tokio manifest edge (normal,
dev or build, any target), ANY tokio package in Cargo.lock, and ANY non-comment
`tokio::` / `#[tokio::test]` in crates/*. There is no allowlist: `edges` and
`lockfile` are kept only so an old reader finds them, and must stay empty.
`not_tokio` lists the crates the old ratchet tracked as 'tokio family' that are not
tokio. Each note's reason is CHECKED against Cargo.lock (no tokio dependency), and
a note whose package left the lock fails as stale.

not_tokio.name: lettre
not_tokio.why: perry-ext-nodemailer uses lettre's `message` builder only; the `tokio1` / `tokio1-rustls-tls` / `pool` transport features are off and the SMTP transport is turnloop-smtp. Its Cargo.lock entry has no tokio dependency.

not_tokio.name: tungstenite
not_tokio.why: Synchronous WebSocket protocol crate. perry-ui-android (`src/ws.rs`, Android targets only) drives it over a blocking std::net::TcpStream on one std thread per connection, and turnloop-websocket uses it as a codec. Its Cargo.lock entry has no tokio dependency. Migrating the Android client onto turnloop-websocket is mechanical but cannot be built or run from the shared Linux host, so it is not done blind here.
